title: Storm Sorceress Over Sea
description: A winged female figure with flowing teal hair and ornate dark armor hovers at the center of a massive turquoise waterspout. She holds a glowing blue staff with a trident-like top, surrounded by lightning, cargo ships, industrial cranes, and floating solar panels in a stormy maritime scene.
prompt: A majestic female sorceress with large teal and gold feathered wings, long flowing turquoise hair, wearing ornate dark blue and black armor, floating in the center of a powerful swirling turquoise waterspout above a stormy ocean. She holds a tall glowing blue magical staff with a trident orb top, one arm outstretched. Dramatic dark blue stormy sky with lightning bolts, industrial harbor with cargo ships and cranes in the background, floating solar panels and smaller ethereal figures in the turbulent water below, high detail fantasy scene.
